name: Lady Alarielle of Avelorn
description: A serene and enigmatic figure, she wanders the sacred groves of Avelorn, tending to the Everqueen’s gardens and whispering to the spirits of the land.

name: Caelir Stormblade
description: One of the few Yvressians who still believes in the need for vigilant defense, Caelir tirelessly patrols the mists, ever watchful for the next greenskin invasion.

name: Vaedion Fireheart
description: A noble warrior bound to an aging dragon, Vaedion seeks to restore Caledor’s former glory, but he struggles with the arrogance that plagues his people.

name: Selendra Wavecaller
description: A practitioner of High Magic who communes with the tides, Selendra serves as an advisor to Lothern’s fleet and reads omens in the rolling waves.

name: Tyrian Sunrider
description: A reckless but skilled warrior, Tyrian races across the plains of Tiranoc in a golden chariot, eager to prove himself in battle.

name: Aeloris Windborne
description: A seasoned sailor who charts courses through the Great Ocean, Aeloris has seen sights beyond Ulthuan that few others can even imagine.

name: Boris Kladivo
description: A gruff and pragmatic leader, Boris commands a band of horse archers that patrol the borders, striking swiftly at any threats from the north.

name: Anya Vostova
description: A mysterious sorceress who wields the chilling power of Kislev’s frozen tundras, Anya is both feared and revered by her people.

name: Sir Gauvain de Montfort
description: A devout knight on an endless journey to prove his valor, Gauvain seeks the Grail but is haunted by doubts and past failures.

name: Mother Isabeau
description: A healer and prophetess who resides in a secluded glade, aiding those who are deemed worthy by the Lady of the Lake.

name: Gunther Eisenwolf
description: A relentless hunter of heretics and mutants, Eisenwolf’s faith in Sigmar is unshakable, but his methods are as brutal as the evils he fights.

name: Lorenzo Belladonna
description: A cunning sellsword with a silver tongue, Lorenzo always has an angle, whether on the battlefield or at the negotiating table.

name: Juan Estebano
description: A master of the rapier who fights for honor, wealth, and sport, Juan’s pride is only matched by his flamboyance.

name: Morvhal Daggerheart
description: A cold and calculating noble who commands a fleet of Black Arks, Morvhal delights in the suffering of his enemies.

name: Selendra the Flayer
description: One of the deadliest warriors of Khaine, Selendra revels in bloodshed and sees each kill as an offering to her dark god.

name: Vaelor Soulstealer
description: A gifted but ruthless sorcerer who experiments with forbidden magic, constantly seeking more power to bend to his will.

name: Ulfgar the Bloodied
description: A brutal warlord who leads his marauders in endless raids, Ulfgar is favored by the Dark Gods and has never known defeat.

name: Freya the Howling Storm
description: A Norscan witch who claims to hear the whispers of the gods in the raging storms, her visions guide warriors to both glory and doom.

name: Talanor Shadowbough
description: A silent guardian of the forest, Talanor stalks trespassers with an uncanny patience, striking only when necessary.

name: Naestra Moonsinger
description: A mystical elf who communes with the spirits of the forest, weaving spells that bind the glades in harmony or bring destruction to intruders.
